Module com.example.demo
Package com.example.miniproyecto4.model

Class Board

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto4.model.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a Battleship game board. This class manages ship placement, shot processing, occupied coordinates, and the overall state of the board during a match. It also provides the information required to determine whether all ships have been destroyed.
